rationale.ai-review: Tests correlated error failures and reliability limits of AI reviewers.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Demonstrates BDD tests catch domain bugs that AI reviewers miss.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against deploying AI reviewers without deterministic external specifications.
rationale.intro-framing: Position paper framing AI review limits without operationalizing new mechanisms.
rationale.agentic: Studies AI reviewer agents validating complete generated artifacts.
rationale.risk-quality: Evaluates detection of functional correctness and domain logic bugs.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled test of AI reviewer models on planted bug corpus.
